A.task_instruction: Transcribe the speech verbatim exactly as spoken. Never insert, repeat, or add any word you do not clearly hear in the audio. Output only the transcript text.

error_shape.boundary: Every figure in this file is a DIAGNOSTIC computed after the fact on sealed outputs. None of it is the verdict, none of it was fitted, and the two transforms marked oracle = true use the reference's own length and are upper bounds on a component rather than achievable numbers.

hypothesis_immediate_repeats_collapsed.what: collapse runs of an identical word in the HYPOTHESIS only

both_sides_immediate_repeats_collapsed.what: collapse runs of an identical word on BOTH sides

hypothesis_truncated_to_reference_length.what: cut each hypothesis to its own reference word count -- an ORACLE transform that bounds the over-generation component from above and is not an achievable result

dedup_then_truncate.what: both of the above, composed; also an ORACLE bound

empty_reference_after_normalization.note: a reference that normalizes to nothing (an isolated 'Um.', 'mm-hmm <affirmative>.' or '<inaudible>.') contributes zero reference words to the denominator while any hypothesis words it draws are counted as insertions in the numerator. Four rows of 2,735; the effect on the corpus figure is a few hundredths of a point and is recorded rather than removed.

non_english_hypotheses.note: hypotheses containing CJK-range characters, all on sub-second clips. A real defect of the frozen core on near-empty audio, three rows of 2,735.

held_constant: the roster, the derived media bytes, the derived reference layer, the scorers, the build, the quantization, the audio path, the serving geometry, the decoding parameters, the harness and the entry point. Arms A and B differ from each other in the instruction TEXT only; arm C differs from arm B in the request SHAPE only, at a byte-identical instruction string.

C-A.convention: metric = NEGATED per-utterance Whisper-normalized WER, so delta = A_wer - C_wer is POSITIVE when arm C is better and 'saves' counts utterances arm C improves

corpus_level_delta.convention: A_corpus_wer - C_corpus_wer in points: POSITIVE when arm C is better
corpus_level_delta.note: the same stratified resampling rule and seed the per-utterance contrast uses, applied to the corpus statistic, which is the paper-facing aggregation

decision.rule: the preregistered rule is stated on contrast C-A: arm C is adopted if its pooled corpus Whisper-normalized WER beats arm A, the paired CI90 lower bound is above 0, and the hypothesis-to-reference length ratio falls toward 1.0
decision.length_ratio_condition_as_preregistered: strictly below the left arm's pooled hypothesis/reference word ratio
decision.why_both_readings_are_reported: the preregistered clause reads 'strictly below', which a catastrophic UNDER-generation would also satisfy while overshooting 1.0. It cannot change the outcome, because the rule is a conjunction whose first condition is that the arm's corpus WER actually beats the control, and under-generation raises WER. Both readings are printed so a reader never has to take that on trust.

band_indication_only.caveat: INDICATION ONLY. These ten calls are this study's dev subset10, not the published ESB test subset, and no published number covers them. No alignment verdict is issued here.
